semiconductor_relevance: Medium — JIMMORE International Co., Ltd. provides precision tooling and measurement solutions that are relevant for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: JIMMORE International Co., Ltd. specializes in precision tooling and measurement solutions, offering products such as tool presetters, measuring machines, and tool management systems. Their focus on high-quality machinery and customer service aims to enhance processing and production efficiency in various manufacturing sectors, including semiconductors.

regional_presence.Taiwan: JIMMORE has a strong presence in Taiwan, particularly in the central and southern regions, serving various manufacturing sectors.
